name: Simplified Dual Contouring
definition: A simplified isosurface extraction method that places a single vertex at the center of every voxel cell where the scalar field values at the eight corners exhibit a sign change along any axis-aligned edge, and constructs a quad mesh by connecting these vertices based on their relative positions in the grid.
summary: Simplified Dual Contouring is an isosurface extraction method that places vertices at voxel centers and connects them via fixed rules, avoiding the complex QEF optimization of standard Dual Contouring.
